geom_smooth: method="auto" and size of largest group is <1000, so using loess. Use 'method = x' to change the smoothing method.

messages.subject: Re: geom_smooth says largest group is <1000 but there are greater values?
parts:
Hi,

I am not sure what exactly you expected. Do you mean a "linear" trend line?
You will get one with:

geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm")

if you want to have it without standard errors you need to add: ,se = FALSE

Best,
David
